verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a generic candidate rating endpoint, an MCP ability to "rate and review" candidates, and a pipeline stages listing. None of this documents structured scorecards with defined attributes per stage, interviewer-specific rubrics, or cross-candidate comparison. A plain rating is an adjacent feature, not the structured-scorecard capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews are scored on structured scorecards — defined attributes per stage, focused rubrics per interviewer, comparable across candidates
